SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF SEP-13-2023 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF SEP-13-2023 BY JUDGE PRO TEM WILLIAM LYNN. PLAINTIFF ALEXANDER GLAVIN IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT BRENDA LEE IS PRESENT WITH WITNESS YU BING CHAN. THE COURT AMENDS PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM TO ADD DEFENDANT YU BING CHAN AND DEFENDANT RORY SHING CHEE CHAN. THE COURT DISMISSES PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM AGAINST DEFENDANT BRENDA LEE WITH PREJUDICE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: WILLIAM LYNN; CLERK: S. KANE. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-13-2023 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF GLAVIN, ALEXANDER RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT CHAN, YU BING CHAN, RORY SHING CHEE $5,000.00 PRINCIPAL, $90.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $5,090.00, THE CLAIM WAS AMENDED BY THE COURT TO REFLECT THE CORRECT DEFENDANTS, AND THE CLAIM AGAINST DEFENDANT BRENDA LEE IS DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE. COURT FINDS THE FORMER LANDLORDS ACTED IN BAD FAITH, THUS WARRANTING ADDITIONAL DAMAGE TO BE AWARDED - SEE ATTACHMENT NO 1 (MC-025). STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
